name: Mórichida (Hungary)
description: White field with a wavy red stripe along the top edge and a wavy green stripe along the bottom edge, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Mórichida: a crowned red and green shield with a cross, a heart, a church and a bunch of grapes and the year 1242, within a green wreath, above a scroll inscribed MÓRICHIDA.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Mórichida arms with crown, wreath and scroll
